name: RawNeRF
definition: A method that modifies Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) to reconstruct scenes in linear HDR color space by supervising directly on noisy raw input images, rather than postprocessed low dynamic range (LDR) images.
summary: RawNeRF trains NeRF on raw linear images to preserve HDR dynamic range, enabling post-rendering exposure adjustment and denoising unlike standard LDR variants.
